multicast.stream_profile: FIRST plus DATA packets with byte sequence space
multicast.go_back_n: receiver CNTL RSEQ selects rollback byte; sender resumes from containing segment
multicast.allocation_pacing: sender advances only within minimum receiver ALLOC after population discovery
multicast.reject_suppression: receiver multicasts reject notice and suppresses its own reject when an observed RSEQ is <= its required RSEQ
multicast.rate_control: sender honors minimum receiver RATE/BURST from CNTL; RATE=0xffffffff disables pacing
